digest.component_or_area: plan-review & code-review documentation and CLI/MCP explain interface
propositions: Authors cannot easily discover how to write a plan that passes the plan-review gate because existing material only covers gate mechanics or is reviewer-facing criterion registry
The CLI rebar explain command and MCP explain_criterion tool lack author-guide paths, forcing users to interpret the per-criterion rubric as an on-ramp
AGENTS.md incorrectly points authors at the criterion registry for the description template, creating pointer confusion
New prose on-ramp docs (writing-a-passing-plan.md, passing-code-review.md) must be routable via shared registry lookup across library, CLI, and MCP interfaces
Acceptance requires new docs to be linkable from docs/README.md and testable via unit tests covering unknown-name and missing-file error paths
